focus: Security — classifier transport and hook process boundary

findingDetails.title: Page byte size is unbounded before screening timeout
findingDetails.evidence: prepareSections splits the full input and derives sections by line ranges; screenText starts its deadline only after preparation, then submits each complete section as classifier stdin.
findingDetails.impact: A very large newline-free or minified fetched response can trigger large allocations and repeated classifier payloads before the hook budget applies, causing a local stall or memory exhaustion.
findingDetails.recommendation: Apply a UTF-8 byte cap before splitting and before any classifier dispatch; retain truncation/unchecked status and cover a very long single-line response.
findingDetails.scopeProof: The source is included in the supplied goal-file-manifest.txt at line 251.

noveltyJustification: One new P2 finding contributes weight 1 of total new severity weight 1.

reviewDepthApplicability.reason: The release target covers 1,997 files; this pass inspected the hook/classifier transport slice and leaves broader manifest security for later passes.

targetSelection.selectionReason: Followed fetched text from hook input through feature gate and child-process transport, focusing on untrusted input size, shell boundaries, logs and switches.
omittedHighRiskTargets: other manifest-wide security paths outside the classifier hook slice

searchLedger.hypothesis: A page with few lines but extreme line length can bypass the line-count bound and consume unbounded resources before screening.

searchActions.queryOrPath: prepareSections, splitSections, toLines, screenText and classifier stdin
searchActions.result: Input is split by newline and sections are capped only by line count. Full preparation precedes the deadline; complete section text is sent to the classifier.

searchLedger.rationale: A large newline-free fetched response bypasses all byte bounds and is prepared before the classifier deadline.

searchLedger.hypothesis: Fetched text may be reinterpreted as shell syntax when sent to the classifier.

searchActions.queryOrPath: classifier call arguments and child spawn
searchActions.result: Arguments are an argv array and fetched content is written to stdin; no shell command is composed from the page text.

searchLedger.rationale: Traced untrusted text to child input and inspected spawn call shape.
searchLedger.ruledOutReason: No shell interpolation path was found in this call chain.

searchLedger.hypothesis: Credential or fetched page content may be written to hook logs during readiness or classification.

searchActions.queryOrPath: screen report callback, jev auth status and child stdio
searchActions.result: Screen report callback is a no-op; auth output is piped and readiness returns only status; adapter emits a static advisory.

searchLedger.rationale: Read credential readiness and hook output paths.
searchLedger.ruledOutReason: No credential value or fetched body is written to the adapter’s output/log path.

searchLedger.hypothesis: An operator off-switch may be ignored and the screen still invoked.

searchActions.queryOrPath: shared hook flag to featureReady to screenText
searchActions.result: Adapter checks the hook concern before reading input; featureReady checks master and feature switches before auth/classifier calls.

searchLedger.rationale: Followed hook-level and Jev feature-level switches to the classifier call.
searchLedger.ruledOutReason: No bypass found in the shared adapter path.
